declarations.notes: Positive-real, positive-dimensional parameters z : Fin n → ℝ (with 0 < n) replace the source complex parameters. The typed simplex uses domainIntegrable for convergence and domainIntegral for the value; zero-base Real.rpow values on the simplex boundary are a.e. representatives.

Positive-real, positive-dimensional parameters z : Fin (n+1) → ℝ (with 0 < n) and the residual barycentric coordinate are explicit. Convergence and value are separate declarations over the typed simplex; zero-base Real.rpow values on the boundary are a.e. representatives.
The Vandermonde product is recorded directly over real coordinate vectors.

Positive-real a,b with admissible real c; n ≥ 2 is imposed so the source's displayed n−1 denominators are literal. The typed cube, domainIntegrable convergence statement, and domainIntegral value statement are separate. firstCoordinateSelection hmn is the canonical first-coordinate inclusion; selbergIndex n k = n − k.1 − 1 in ℝ avoids truncated Nat subtraction. Real.rpow on boundary/diagonal null sets is an a.e. representative.

Positive-real a with admissible real c on the typed positive orthant; n ≥ 2 is imposed for the displayed n−1 denominators. Convergence is domainIntegrable and the source value is domainIntegral; firstCoordinateSelection supplies the canonical moment coordinates. Real.rpow on boundary/diagonal null sets is an a.e. representative.

The source's complex c is specialized to real c with 0 < n. wholeSpace n is a typed full-dimensional domain; its domainIntegrable convergence declaration is separate from the normalized domainIntegral value. Real.rpow on the Vandermonde diagonal null set is an a.e. representative.

The source's complex b is specialized to real b with 0 < n; unit-circle factors remain complex before taking their norms. dysonCube n is typed, and convergence is separate from the normalized domainIntegral value. Real.rpow on collision hyperplanes is an a.e. representative.
